intro.p1: Do you feel insecure about the darkening of your intimate areas? You are not alone.
intro.p2: At MJ Estética & Wellness Center we offer Intimate Area Whitening protocols designed to unify skin tone in delicate areas (bikini line, armpits, perianal area) in a safe, respectful, and professional way.

causes.title: Why does the intimate area darken?
causes.intro: Darkening (hyperpigmentation) in intimate areas is very common and can be due to multiple factors that affect your daily confidence:

items.d: Chafing from tight clothing or skin-to-skin contact generates a melanin defensive response.
Pregnancy, use of contraceptives, or menopause can darken specific areas.
Constant use of razors or hot wax irritates the area and causes post-inflammatory spots.
Some skin types tend to pigment more easily in body folds.

protocol.title: Our Whitening Protocol
protocol.desc: We combine aesthetic technology and enzymatic peelings specific for sensitive areas.

steps.d: We analyze the degree of pigmentation and skin condition to personalize the number of sessions.
We apply depigmenting actives that lighten the area without causing burns or severe irritation.
We provide you with the guidelines to maintain results and prevent the area from darkening again.

benefits.title: Benefits of Intimate Depigmentation
items: Feel more comfortable wearing a bikini or underwear
Eliminate spots from chafing or post-hair removal
Improve the texture and softness of the treated area

items.q: Is it safe for sensitive skin?
items.a: Absolutely. We use enzymatic peelings and latest generation actives designed specifically for delicate areas, avoiding aggressive irritation.

items.q: How many sessions do I need?
items.a: It depends on the degree of pigmentation. Generally, between 4 and 6 sessions are recommended for optimal and lasting results.

items.q: Can it be done on armpits too?
items.a: Yes, the protocol is excellent for armpits, bikini line, perianal area, and darkened knees/elbows.

items.q: Does hair interfere with the treatment?
items.a: We recommend the area be shaved (preferably 48h before) so the actives penetrate the skin better.
No. It is a non-invasive topical treatment. You may feel a slight tingling or momentary heat.
